name: Giblet Gravy
description: Historical recipe from The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Pour off liquid in pan in which chicken has been roasted
From liquid skim off four tablespoons fat; return fat to pan, and brown with four tablespoons flour
Add two cups stock in which giblets, neck, and tips of wings have been cooked
Cook five minutes, season with salt and pepper, then strain
Add giblets (heart, liver, and gizzard) finely chopped

source.author: Fannie Merritt Farmer
source.originalInstructions:
1. Pour off liquid in pan in which chicken has been roasted
2. From liquid skim off four tablespoons fat; return fat to pan, and brown with four tablespoons flour
3. Add two cups stock in which giblets, neck, and tips of wings have been cooked
4. Cook five minutes, season with salt and pepper, then strain
5. Add giblets (heart, liver, and gizzard) finely chopped
